dek: Set for 13 September 2026 at AEON Mall Rawang in Selangor, this JomRun-powered half marathon offers three distances with registration open.
verdict: The Rawang Half Marathon Powered by JomRun is a convenient, accessible Selangor suburb race anchored at AEON Mall Rawang — a retail location with ample parking and facilities. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open via JomRun. Rawang is a northern Selangor township roughly 30 minutes from KL. September is the inter-monsoon period on the west coast. A straightforward Klang Valley half marathon with JomRun's familiar registration platform.
